approved_scope.title: Global --project <path> flag runs the CLI as if started in that directory: that project's fledge.toml, specs and .env files as Bun loads them there, never the start directory's (CLI-5)
approved_scope.description: Global --project <path> flag runs the CLI as if started in that directory: that project's fledge.toml, specs and .env files as Bun loads them there, never the start directory's (CLI-5)
acceptance_criteria: From another directory, corvidinho --project <path> (before or after the command, before --) makes task run read <path>/fledge.toml and <path>/specs, and loads <path>'s .env files exactly as a process started in <path> gets them (doctor output identical to running there; .env.local and $VAR expansion as Bun; set variables win; the start directory's .env values do not carry over); a missing, non-directory or empty --project prints one corvidinho: line plus hint and exits 1 before any command runs; tests/cli.project-path.test.ts covers these and fails on main
